task_statement: Expose typed flag introspection for JSON Schema generation (issue #2326). Add two optional interfaces in flag.go: SchemaTyper with SchemaType() string, returning the JSON Schema type name of the value a flag accepts ("boolean", "integer", "number", "string", "array", "object", plus "duration"/"date-time" for time.Duration/time.Time values, or "" if the flag does not map cleanly), and SchemaItemsTyper with SchemaItemsType() string, returning the element type for array-valued flags and "" for single-value or object flags. Implement both generically on FlagBase[T, C, V] in flag_impl.go so every built-in flag type gets them, and on BoolWithInverseFlag (flag_bool_with_inverse.go) and extFlag (flag_ext.go, wrapping standard-library flag.Flag values by inspecting e.Get()). Add tests in flag_schema_type_test.go covering the built-in flag types and extFlag type branches, and regenerate godoc-current.txt and testdata/godoc-v3.x.txt.
